text: {"lessons":["I will avoid making large decisions based only on a few months of price moves; short-term swings do not establish a reliable trend.","I will use a consistent plan for position size and for when to buy, hold, or sell, rather than treating recent gains or losses as a reason by themselves to trade.","I will preserve enough cash and spread risk across holdings so I can act without borrowing or being forced to sell at an unfavorable time."]}
